title: Add Structured Request Logger Middleware
description: Provides built‑in request logging with configurable log levels and JSON/pretty output. Improves observability in production without adding external dependencies, helping operators debug issues and monitor traffic patterns.
testCases: Verify that a GET request logs method, url, status, response time in the default format
Verify that logger respects custom config: logLevel='error' only logs error responses
Verify that logger can output JSON when format='json' and that the JSON structure contains expected fields
Ensure static file requests are logged according to the same rules
Confirm that logger does not crash on malformed request objects
acceptance: When the middleware is enabled, every incoming request results in a correctly formatted log entry respecting the configured level and format; no errors are thrown for any request type, and the logs can be captured by the test suite via a mocked console.
reason: Observability is a critical production requirement. Adding a zero‑dependency, configurable logger directly into yantraverse gives developers immediate insight into request flow, reduces reliance on external tools, and aligns with the framework’s lightweight philosophy.
